subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: This 6-day tour flies with Air China from Manila to Beijing, where you see Tiananmen Square, the Forbidden City, the Juyongguan Great Wall and a Hanfu experience. You then fly to Xi’an for the Ancient City Wall, the Terracotta Army and the Big Wild Goose Pagoda. All hotels are local 5-star, and the programme includes several shop stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Feb 21–26 2027 to Feb 28–Mar 5 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Water Cube: The Beijing 2008 Olympic swimming arena with a bubble-like facade; outside view only.
placeDesc.Bird’s Nest: Beijing's Olympic stadium with its steel lattice design; outside view only.
placeDesc.Wangfujing Walking Street: A busy pedestrian shopping street in central Beijing with stores and snack stalls.
placeDesc.Tiananmen Square: Beijing's vast central square, flanked by the Great Hall of the People and the gate to the Forbidden City.
placeDesc.Forbidden City: The former imperial palace of China's Ming and Qing emperors in the heart of Beijing.
placeDesc.Juyongguan Great Wall: A well-preserved section of the Great Wall in a mountain pass north of Beijing.
placeDesc.Qianmen Old Street: A restored traditional pedestrian street south of Tiananmen Square, with shops and snacks.
placeDesc.Xi’an Ancient City Wall: The city wall of Xi'an, one of the best-preserved ancient city walls in China.
placeDesc.Terracotta Army: Thousands of life-size clay warriors guarding the tomb of China's first emperor, near Xi'an.
placeDesc.Great Tang All Day Mall: A Tang-dynasty themed shopping and dining district in Xi'an, visited after the dinner.
placeDesc.Big Wild Goose Pagoda: A Tang-dynasty Buddhist pagoda in Xi'an, one of the city's best-known landmarks.
placeDesc.Bell Tower: A Ming-dynasty tower standing at the centre of Xi'an's old city.
placeDesc.Bell and Drum Tower Square: The plaza between Xi'an's Bell Tower and Drum Tower in the old city centre.
placeDesc.Summer Palace (optional): Optional tour of Beijing's imperial garden palace beside Kunming Lake, boat ride not included.
placeDesc.Panda House, Beijing Zoo (optional): Optional visit to the giant panda house at Beijing Zoo.
